data.title: 埃塔 · 实验台旁的秒速昏睡
data.action: 抱着厚厚的设计图纸整个人栽倒在实验椅里呼呼大睡，连体睡衣大帽子半遮住眼睛，嘴里发出可爱的小呼噜
data.location: 暗影庭园第六研究所主实验台旁的懒人沙发上
data.lighting: 荧光显微镜与多排培养皿发出的冷翠绿微光，与实验台暖白工作灯将沉睡的少女笼罩
data.mood: 深度嗜睡、天然呆萌、无防备的科研天才日常
data.description: 暗影庭园科技研究所的深夜。被公认为组织最强智慧却也是最嗜睡的埃塔，穿着一套松垮得能把整个人装进去的猫耳摇粒绒连体睡衣。手里还死死抓着新魔导兵器的羊皮纸图纸，整个人却已经一头栽倒在特大号懒人豆袋沙发里陷入深度睡眠。猫耳大兜帽歪歪斜斜地盖住眼睛，露出一小撮紫发，嘴角隐隐挂着一丝浅浅的睡口水——「呼……呼……暗影大人的……新式充能装置……呼呼……睡十秒……就起……」
data.promptProse: Slumped deep into an oversized beanbag chair inside her subterranean laboratory at midnight, Eta sleeps soundly swallowed inside a baggy lavender polar-fleece cat-ear onesie with extra-long sleeves. Still clutching glowing magical schematics to her chest as she breathes softly, she is bathed in cool emerald lab light and a warm desk lamp.
data.animaCaption: Slumped fast asleep in a soft beanbag chair swallowed by her baggy lavender fleece cat-ear onesie, she clutches crumpled magical blueprints against her chest with a tiny sleepy drool. Cool emerald laboratory glow mixes with a warm work lamp over the desk.
data.nsfwProse: She wears an ultra-oversized slouchy lavender fleece kigurumi onesie with a cat-ear hood pulled loosely over her head and extra-long drooping sleeves.
